args.title: Fix weekly schedule skipping its first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

When a weekly report schedule is created, nextRunAt(cadence, from) appears to always add a full week to the creation time rather than finding the nearest upcoming occurrence of the schedule's run time. For daily cadences this is harmless since the interval is only a day, but for weekly cadences it causes the very first export to be skipped: a schedule created early Monday morning waits a full 7 days before its first send instead of sending that same day (or at the next correct occurrence).

Please update the weekly branch of nextRunAt (and firstRunAt in src/api/reports.ts, which calls it) so that the first scheduled run is computed as the next occurrence of the target day/time at or after the creation time, rather than unconditionally creation time + 7 days. This should make newly created weekly schedules send on their first intended Monday instead of silently skipping it, matching the behavior users see with daily schedules.
